name: 06460 · Milford, CT
findings: ZIP 06460 (Milford) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06460 (Milford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06460 (Milford) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
